fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE soulève la question de savoir à quel organe de la Société sera soumis le rapport futur du Comité. C'est le Conseil qui a nommé les membres du Comité, et si ce rapport n'est pas accepté par le Conseil, celui-ci ne le renverra pas à l'Assemblée.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE raised the question as to which organ of the League the future report of the Committee would be submitted. The Council was the organ by which the members of the Committee had been named and if the report was not accepted by the Council, the latter would not refer it to the Assembly.
